# Environment Variables

Pi uses environment variables in three ways:

- Variables such as `PI_OFFLINE` configure the Pi process.
- Pi sets process markers so child processes can identify Pi as the launching agent.
- Commands run by the LLM-callable shell tools receive `PI_*` variables describing the current session.

Provider API-key variables are documented separately in [Providers](providers.md#use-an-api-key-from-the-environment).

## Process Marker

The CLI and RPC entry points set two process markers:

- `AI_AGENT=pi` is a generic marker that lets tooling identify Pi as the agent that launched the process.
- `PI_CODING_AGENT=true` is Pi-specific and lets child processes detect that they run inside Pi.

Child processes inherit both markers. They are not session-specific and are not set automatically when Pi is embedded through the SDK.

## Shell Tool Session Environment

Commands run by the `bash` and `powershell` tools receive the current Pi session state:

| Variable | Description |
|----------|-------------|
| `PI_SESSION_ID` | Current session ID |
| `PI_SESSION_FILE` | Absolute path to the current session JSONL file; unset for ephemeral sessions |
| `PI_PROVIDER` | Currently selected model provider |
| `PI_MODEL` | Currently selected model ID |
| `PI_REASONING_LEVEL` | Current effective reasoning level: `off`, `minimal`, `low`, `medium`, `high`, `xhigh`, or `max` |

The values are resolved when each command starts. Switching models or changing the reasoning level therefore affects the next shell command without restarting Pi. `PI_PROVIDER` and `PI_MODEL` identify the selected Pi model, not a different upstream model that a router may choose internally.

When asked which model or provider is running, inspect these variables instead of inferring the answer from the system prompt:

```bash
printf '%s/%s\n' "$PI_PROVIDER" "$PI_MODEL"
printf 'reasoning=%s session=%s\n' "$PI_REASONING_LEVEL" "$PI_SESSION_ID"
```

The session file can be inspected directly when the session is persistent:

```bash
if [ -n "$PI_SESSION_FILE" ]; then
  tail -n 1 "$PI_SESSION_FILE"
fi
```

These variables are injected into the LLM-callable `bash` and `powershell` tools. They are not injected into user-entered `!` or `!!` commands.

<!doctype html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="utf-8"/>
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1"/>
<meta name="color-scheme" content="dark"/>
<title>Ramen — Atmospheric Hero</title>
<style>
  html, body {
    margin: 0;
    padding: 0;
    height: 100%;
    background: #080605;
    overflow: hidden;
  }
  #scene {
    display: block;
    width: 100vw;
    height: 100vh;
    cursor: default;
  }
</style>
</head>
<body>
<canvas id="scene" role="img" aria-label="A steaming bowl of vegan ramen on a dark table beneath warm lamplight"></canvas>
<script>
(function () {
  'use strict';

  var canvas = document.getElementById('scene');
  var ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');

  /* ---------------- state ---------------- */
  var W = 0, H = 0, DPR = 1;
  var G = {};                 // layout metrics
  var grain = null;           // offscreen noise pattern canvas
  var grainPattern = null;

  var mouse = { x: 0.5, y: 0.5 };      // smoothed
  var target = { x: 0.5, y: 0.5 };     // goal

  var ripples = [];                    // {x,y(local -1..1), r, vx, a}
  var bubbles = [];                    // {x,y,r,life,maxLife}
  var recentRippleAt = -10;
  var recentBubbleAt = -10;

  var mq = window.matchMedia('(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)');
  var motion = !mq.matches;

  /* ---------------- deterministic PRNG ---------------- */
  function mulberry32(seed) {
    var a = seed >>> 0;
    return function () {
      a |= 0; a = (a + 0x6D2B79F5) | 0;
      var t = Math.imul(a ^ (a >>> 15), 1 | a);
      t = (t + Math.imul(t ^ (t >>> 7), 61 | t)) ^ t;
      return ((t ^ (t >>> 14)) >>> 0) / 4294967296;
    };
  }

  /* ---------------- layout ---------------- */
  function layout() {
    var unit = Math.min(W, H);
    G.unit = unit;
    G.cx = W / 2;
    G.R = Math.max(100, Math.min(unit * 0.315, 310));
    G.RY = G.R * 0.335;
    G.rimY = H * (H > W ? 0.46 : 0.505);
    G.depth = G.R * 0.62;
    G.baseY = G.rimY + G.depth;
    G.tableY = G.baseY + G.R * 0.115;
    G.innerR = G.R * 0.795;
    G.innerRY = G.RY * 0.72;
    G.footRx = G.R * 0.36;
    G.footRy = G.RY * 0.26;
  }

  function resize() {
    DPR = Math.min(window.devicePixelRatio || 1, 2);
    W = window.innerWidth; H = window.innerHeight;
    canvas.width = Math.round(W * DPR);
    canvas.height = Math.round(H * DPR);
    canvas.style.width = W + 'px';
    canvas.style.height = H + 'px';
    ctx.setTransform(DPR, 0, 0, DPR, 0, 0);
    layout();
    if (!motion) render(STATIC_T);
  }

  /* ---------------- grain ---------------- */
  function makeGrain() {
    var c = document.createElement('canvas');
    c.width = c.height = 144;
    var g = c.getContext('2d');
    var img = g.createImageData(144, 144);
    var rnd = mulberry32(1234567);
    for (var i = 0; i < img.data.length; i += 4) {
      var v = (rnd() * 255) | 0;
      img.data[i] = v; img.data[i + 1] = v; img.data[i + 2] = v;
      img.data[i + 3] = 16 + (rnd() * 14) | 0;
    }
    g.putImageData(img, 0, 0);
    grain = c;
    grainPattern = ctx.createPattern(grain, 'repeat');
  }

  /* ---------------- scenery ---------------- */
  function drawBackground(t, lamp, wind) {
    var g = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, 0, 0, H);
    g.addColorStop(0, '#171009');
    g.addColorStop(0.42, '#0f0b09');
    g.addColorStop(1, '#070504');
    ctx.fillStyle = g;
    ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);

    var gx = G.cx + (mouse.x - 0.5) * W * 0.09;
    var pulse = lamp; // lamp flicker 0.97..1.03

    ctx.save();
    ctx.globalCompositeOperation = 'lighter';

    // light cone from an unseen lamp above
    var cone = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, -20, 0, H * 0.95);
    cone.addColorStop(0, 'rgba(255,178,96,' + (0.20 * pulse) + ')');
    cone.addColorStop(0.45, 'rgba(255,150,72,' + (0.065 * pulse) + ')');
    cone.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(255,150,72,0)');
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(gx - W * 0.055, -30);
    ctx.lineTo(gx + W * 0.055, -30);
    ctx.lineTo(gx + W * 0.36, H);
    ctx.lineTo(gx - W * 0.36, H);
    ctx.closePath();
    ctx.fillStyle = cone;
    ctx.fill();

    // lamp hotspot
    var hot = ctx.createRadialGradient(gx, -H * 0.10, 0, gx, -H * 0.10, H * 0.62);
    hot.addColorStop(0, 'rgba(255,196,116,' + (0.30 * pulse) + ')');
    hot.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(255,196,116,0)');
    ctx.fillStyle = hot;
    ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);

    ctx.restore();
  }

  function drawTable(t) {
    var tableY = G.tableY;
    var g = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, tableY, 0, H);
    g.addColorStop(0, '#2a1d12');
    g.addColorStop(0.06, '#201712');
    g.addColorStop(0.5, '#150f0b');
    g.addColorStop(1, '#0a0705');
    ctx.fillStyle = g;
    ctx.fillRect(0, tableY, W, H - tableY);

    // faint bright seam where table meets darkness
    ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(255,186,110,0.055)';
    ctx.fillRect(0, tableY, W, 2);

    // warm pool of light under the bowl
    ctx.save();
    ctx.globalCompositeOperation = 'lighter';
    ctx.translate(G.cx, tableY + G.R * 0.16);
    ctx.scale(1, 0.27);
    var pool = ctx.createRadialGradient(0, 0, 0, 0, 0, G.R * 1.42);
    pool.addColorStop(0, 'rgba(255,150,66,0.17)');
    pool.addColorStop(0.55, 'rgba(255,140,60,0.07)');
    pool.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(255,140,60,0)');
    ctx.fillStyle = pool;
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(0, 0, G.R * 1.42, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.fill();
    ctx.restore();

    // soft bronze reflection streak beneath the bowl
    ctx.save();
    ctx.translate(G.cx, tableY + G.R * 0.24);
    ctx.scale(1, 0.30);
    var refl = ctx.createRadialGradient(0, 0, 0, 0, 0, G.R * 0.72);
    refl.addColorStop(0, 'rgba(255,140,58,0.13)');
    refl.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(255,140,58,0)');
    ctx.fillStyle = refl;
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(0, 0, G.R * 0.72, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.fill();
    ctx.restore();
  }

  function drawShadow() {
    ctx.save();
    ctx.translate(G.cx, G.baseY + G.R * 0.045);
    ctx.scale(1, 0.26);
    var sh = ctx.createRadialGradient(0, 0, 0, 0, 0, G.R * 1.02);
    sh.addColorStop(0, 'rgba(0,0,0,0.62)');
    sh.addColorStop(0.7, 'rgba(0,0,0,0.30)');
    sh.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(0,0,0,0)');
    ctx.fillStyle = sh;
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(0, 0, G.R * 1.02, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.fill();
    ctx.restore();
  }

  function drawDust(t, wind) {
    ctx.save();
    ctx.globalCompositeOperation = 'lighter';
    for (var i = 0; i < dust.length; i++) {
      var m = dust[i];
      if (motion) {
        m.y -= m.speed * 0.00016;
        m.x += Math.sin(t * 0.6 + m.phase) * 0.00004 + wind * 0.00006;
        if (m.y < -0.05) { m.y = 1.05; m.x = Math.random(); }
      }
      var px = (m.x + wind * 0.02) * W;
      var py = m.y * H;
      var tw = 0.5 + 0.5 * Math.sin(t * m.tw + m.phase);
      var a = (0.05 + tw * 0.28) * (1 - py / H);   // dimmer near the bottom
      if (a <= 0.01) continue;
      ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(255,214,160,' + a.toFixed(3) + ')';
      ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(px, py, m.r, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.fill();
    }
    ctx.restore();
  }

  /* ---------------- broth contents ---------------- */
  function drawBroth(t) {
    var cx = G.cx, rimY = G.rimY, innerR = G.innerR, innerRY = G.innerRY;

    // base
    var base = ctx.createRadialGradient(cx, rimY - innerRY * 0.12, innerR * 0.06, cx, rimY, innerR * 1.02);
    base.addColorStop(0, '#e59a4e');
    base.addColorStop(0.45, '#c06a28');
    base.addColorStop(0.8, '#6e2f12');
    base.addColorStop(1, '#54230d');
    ctx.fillStyle = base;
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.ellipse(cx, rimY, innerR, innerRY, 0, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.fill();

    ctx.save();
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.ellipse(cx, rimY, innerR, innerRY, 0, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.clip();

    // drifting light streak
    ctx.save();
    ctx.globalCompositeOperation = 'lighter';
    var shx = cx + Math.sin(t * 0.28 + 1.2) * innerR * 0.30 + (mouse.x - 0.5) * innerR * 0.22;
    var shimmer = ctx.createRadialGradient(shx, rimY - innerRY * 0.30, 0, shx, rimY - innerRY * 0.30, innerR * 0.55);
    shimmer.addColorStop(0, 'rgba(255,220,150,0.20)');
    shimmer.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(255,220,150,0)');
    ctx.fillStyle = shimmer;
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.ellipse(shx, rimY, innerR, innerRY, 0, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.fill();
    ctx.restore();

    // chili oil swirl
    ctx.save();
    ctx.globalCompositeOperation = 'source-over';
    ctx.beginPath();
    var turns = Math.PI * 2.6, steps = 70;
    for (var i = 0; i <= steps; i++) {
      var p = i / steps;
      var a = p * turns + 0.9 + Math.sin(t * 0.4) * 0.05;
      var r = p * innerR * 0.58;
      var x = cx + Math.cos(a) * r;
      var y = rimY + Math.sin(a) * r * (innerRY / innerR);
      if (i === 0) ctx.moveTo(x, y); else ctx.lineTo(x, y);
    }
    ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(226,88,28,0.40)';
    ctx.lineWidth = innerR * 0.085;
    ctx.lineCap = 'round';
    ctx.stroke();
    ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(255,140,60,0.35)';
    ctx.lineWidth = innerR * 0.028;
    ctx.stroke();
    ctx.restore();

    // oil droplets
    for (var d = 0; d < oilDrops.length; d++) {
      var o = oilDrops[d];
      var ox = cx + o.x * innerR;
      var oy = rimY + o.y * innerRY;
      var rr = o.r * innerR;
      ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(238,96,30,0.72)';
      ctx.beginPath(); ctx.ellipse(ox, oy, rr, rr * 0.62, 0, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.fill();
      ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(255,190,120,0.55)';
      ctx.beginPath(); ctx.ellipse(ox - rr * 0.28, oy - rr * 0.22, rr * 0.34, rr * 0.20, 0, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.fill();
    }

    // noodles
    for (var n = 0; n < noodles.length; n++) {
      var s = noodles[n];
      ctx.beginPath();
      for (var j = 0; j <= 26; j++) {
        var pp = j / 26;
        var lx = s.a + (s.b - s.a) * pp;
        var ly = s.c + (s.d - s.c) * pp + Math.sin(pp * Math.PI * 2 * s.waves + s.phase + t * s.speed) * s.amp;
        var x = cx + lx * innerR * 0.86;
        var y = rimY + ly * innerRY * 0.86;
        if (j === 0) ctx.moveTo(x, y); else ctx.lineTo(x, y);
      }
      ctx.strokeStyle = '#c99a4e';
      ctx.lineWidth = innerR * 0.075;
      ctx.lineCap = 'round';
      ctx.stroke();
      ctx.strokeStyle = '#f0d286';
      ctx.lineWidth = innerR * 0.045;
      ctx.stroke();
      ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(255,244,196,0.55)';
      ctx.lineWidth = innerR * 0.014;
      ctx.stroke();
    }

    // toppings
    drawToppings(t);

    // bubbles
    ctx.save();
    ctx.globalCompositeOperation = 'lighter';
    for (var b = 0; b < bubbles.length; b++) {
      var bu = bubbles[b];
      var prog = bu.life / bu.maxLife;
      var rr2 = bu.r * (0.6 + prog * 0.9) * innerR;
      var ba = (1 - prog) * 0.55;
      ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(255,220,160,' + ba.toFixed(3) + ')';
      ctx.lineWidth = 1.6;
      ctx.beginPath(); ctx.ellipse(cx + bu.x * innerR, rimY + bu.y * innerRY, rr2, rr2 * 0.62, 0, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.stroke();
      ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(255,235,190,' + (ba * 0.5).toFixed(3) + ')';
      ctx.beginPath(); ctx.ellipse(cx + bu.x * innerR, rimY + bu.y * innerRY, rr2 * 0.35, rr2 * 0.22, 0, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.fill();
    }
    ctx.restore();

    // ripples
    for (var rI = 0; rI < ripples.length; rI++) {
      var rp = ripples[rI];
      var rr3 = rp.r * innerR;
      ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(255,222,168,' + (rp.a * 0.5).toFixed(3) + ')';
      ctx.lineWidth = 1.8;
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.ellipse(cx + rp.x * innerR, rimY + rp.y * innerRY, rr3, rr3 * (innerRY / innerR), 0, 0, Math.PI * 2);
      ctx.stroke();
    }

    ctx.restore(); // unclip

    // inner shadow at the broth/rim edge (gives depth)
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.ellipse(cx, rimY, innerR, innerRY, 0, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.40)';
    ctx.lineWidth = 5;
    ctx.stroke();
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.ellipse(cx, rimY, innerR, innerRY, 0, Math.PI * 0.55, Math.PI * 1.45);
    ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.30)';
    ctx.lineWidth = 2.5;
    ctx.stroke();
  }

  function mushroom(px, py, s, rot) {
    ctx.save();
    ctx.translate(px, py);
    ctx.rotate(rot);
    // stem
    ctx.fillStyle = '#e7d9bd';
    ctx.beginPath();
    if (ctx.roundRect) ctx.roundRect(-s * 0.20, -s * 0.06, s * 0.40, s * 0.52, s * 0.16);
    else ctx.rect(-s * 0.20, -s * 0.06, s * 0.40, s * 0.52);
    ctx.fill();
    // cap
    var cg = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, -s * 0.72, 0, -s * 0.05);
    cg.addColorStop(0, '#dcba92');
    cg.addColorStop(1, '#a1734e');
    ctx.fillStyle = cg;
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.ellipse(0, -s * 0.26, s * 0.68, s * 0.44, 0, Math.PI, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.closePath(); ctx.fill();
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.ellipse(0, -s * 0.25, s * 0.68, s * 0.115, 0, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.fillStyle = '#7d5638';
    ctx.fill();
    ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(255,238,210,0.65)';
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.ellipse(-s * 0.22, -s * 0.50, s * 0.16, s * 0.075, -0.4, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.fill();
    ctx.restore();
  }

  function tofu(px, py, s) {
    ctx.save();
    ctx.translate(px, py);
    // top face
    ctx.fillStyle = '#f3ecd8';
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(-s, -s * 0.42); ctx.lineTo(0, -s * 0.84); ctx.lineTo(s, -s * 0.42); ctx.lineTo(0, 0);
    ctx.closePath(); ctx.fill();
    // left face
    ctx.fillStyle = '#ddd2b8';
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(-s, -s * 0.42); ctx.lineTo(0, 0); ctx.lineTo(0, s * 0.86); ctx.lineTo(-s, s * 0.44);
    ctx.closePath(); ctx.fill();
    // right face
    ctx.fillStyle = '#c7bb9f';
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(s, -s * 0.42); ctx.lineTo(0, 0); ctx.lineTo(0, s * 0.86); ctx.lineTo(s, s * 0.44);
    ctx.closePath(); ctx.fill();
    ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(90,74,50,0.35)';
    ctx.lineWidth = 1.2;
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(-s, -s * 0.42); ctx.lineTo(0, -s * 0.84); ctx.lineTo(s, -s * 0.42); ctx.stroke();
    ctx.restore();
  }

  function bamboo(px, py, s, rot) {
    ctx.save();
    ctx.translate(px, py);
    ctx.rotate(rot);
    ctx.fillStyle = '#ecd9a6';
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.ellipse(0, 0, s, s * 0.66, 0, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.fill();
    ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(112,86,44,0.55)';
    ctx.lineWidth = 1.4;
    for (var i = -1; i <= 1; i++) {
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.ellipse(0, i * s * 0.30, s * 0.78, s * 0.42, 0, Math.PI * 0.12, Math.PI * 0.88);
      ctx.stroke();
    }
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.ellipse(0, 0, s, s * 0.66, 0, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(96,74,40,0.75)';
    ctx.lineWidth = 1.6;
    ctx.stroke();
    ctx.restore();
  }

  function leaf(px, py, s, rot) {
    ctx.save();
    ctx.translate(px, py);
    ctx.rotate(rot);
    var lg = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, -s, 0, s);
    lg.addColorStop(0, '#6da24c');
    lg.addColorStop(1, '#2c5422');
    ctx.fillStyle = lg;
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(0, -s);
    ctx.quadraticCurveTo(s * 0.78, -s * 0.28, 0, s);
    ctx.quadraticCurveTo(-s * 0.78, -s * 0.28, 0, -s);
    ctx.fill();
    ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(226,246,188,0.6)';
    ctx.lineWidth = 1.4;
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(0, -s * 0.78); ctx.lineTo(0, s * 0.78); ctx.stroke();
    ctx.restore();
  }

  function scallion(px, py, s) {
    ctx.save();
    ctx.fillStyle = '#5f9a3f';
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(px, py, s, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.fill();
    ctx.fillStyle = '#e9e2c8';
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(px, py, s * 0.52, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.fill();
    ctx.fillStyle = '#40230f';
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(px, py, s * 0.30, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.fill();
    ctx.restore();
  }

  function sesame(px, py, rot) {
    ctx.save();
    ctx.translate(px, py);
    ctx.rotate(rot);
    ctx.fillStyle = '#f6ead0';
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.ellipse(0, 0, 2.6, 1.6, 0, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.fill();
    ctx.restore();
  }

  function drawToppings(t) {
    var innerR = G.innerR, innerRY = G.innerRY, cx = G.cx, rimY = G.rimY;
    var s = G.unit * 0.002; // scale constant
    for (var i = 0; i < toppings.length; i++) {
      var tp = toppings[i];
      var px = cx + tp.x * innerR;
      var py = rimY + tp.y * innerRY;
      var sz = tp.s * innerR;
      if (tp.type === 'mushroom') mushroom(px, py, sz, tp.rot);
      else if (tp.type === 'tofu') tofu(px, py, sz);
      else if (tp.type === 'bamboo') bamboo(px, py, sz, tp.rot);
      else if (tp.type === 'leaf') leaf(px, py, sz, tp.rot + Math.sin(t * 0.9 + tp.x * 5) * 0.05);
    }
    for (var k = 0; k < scallions.length; k++) {
      var sc = scallions[k];
      scallion(cx + sc.x * innerR, rimY + sc.y * innerRY, sc.r * innerR);
    }
    for (var q = 0; q < sesame.length; q++) {
      var se = sesame[q];
      sesame(cx + se.x * innerR, rimY + se.y * innerRY, se.rot);
    }
  }

  /* ---------------- bowl ---------------- */
  function drawBowl(t) {
    var cx = G.cx, rimY = G.rimY, R = G.R, RY = G.RY, depth = G.depth;
    var baseY = G.baseY;

    // foot
    ctx.save();
    ctx.translate(cx, baseY - depth * 0.02);
    ctx.scale(1, 0.26);
    var foot = ctx.createRadialGradient(0, 0, 0, 0, 0, G.footRx);
    foot.addColorStop(0, '#0c080a');
    foot.addColorStop(0.75, '#171114');
    foot.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(23,17,20,0)');
    ctx.fillStyle = foot;
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(0, 0, G.footRx, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.fill();
    ctx.restore();

    // body
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(cx - R, rimY);
    ctx.bezierCurveTo(cx - R * 1.02, rimY + depth * 0.52, cx - R * 0.60, baseY, cx, baseY);
    ctx.bezierCurveTo(cx + R * 0.60, baseY, cx + R * 1.02, rimY + depth * 0.52, cx + R, rimY);
    ctx.closePath();
    var body = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, rimY - RY, 0, baseY);
    body.addColorStop(0, '#41343a');
    body.addColorStop(0.30, '#251d23');
    body.addColorStop(0.78, '#120d11');
    body.addColorStop(1, '#0b080c');
    ctx.fillStyle = body;
    ctx.fill();

    // warm underlight on the lower body (bounce from the broth)
    ctx.save();
    ctx.clip();
    var bounce = ctx.createRadialGradient(cx, rimY - RY * 0.5, 0, cx, rimY - RY * 0.5, depth * 1.05);
    bounce.addColorStop(0, 'rgba(255,140,60,0.17)');
    bounce.addColorStop(0.55, 'rgba(255,140,60,0.045)');
    bounce.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(255,140,60,0)');
    ctx.fillStyle = bounce;
    ctx.fillRect(cx - R, rimY - RY, R * 2, depth + RY);
    ctx.restore();

    // left-right sheen across body
    ctx.save();
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(cx - R, rimY);
    ctx.bezierCurveTo(cx - R * 1.02, rimY + depth * 0.52, cx - R * 0.60, baseY, cx, baseY);
    ctx.bezierCurveTo(cx + R * 0.60, baseY, cx + R * 1.02, rimY + depth * 0.52, cx + R, rimY);
    ctx.closePath();
    ctx.clip();
    var sheen = ctx.createLinearGradient(cx - R, 0, cx + R, 0);
    sheen.addColorStop(0, 'rgba(0,0,0,0.40)');
    sheen.addColorStop(0.28, 'rgba(255,214,160,0.10)');
    sheen.addColorStop(0.50, 'rgba(255,214,160,0.015)');
    sheen.addColorStop(0.78, 'rgba(0,0,0,0.30)');
    sheen.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(0,0,0,0.55)');
    ctx.fillStyle = sheen;
    ctx.fillRect(cx - R, rimY - RY, R * 2, depth + RY * 2);
    ctx.restore();

    // rim (outer ring)
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.ellipse(cx, rimY, R, RY, 0, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    var rimG = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, rimY - RY, 0, rimY + RY);
    rimG.addColorStop(0, '#55434b');
    rimG.addColorStop(0.45, '#2c232a');
    rimG.addColorStop(1, '#191318');
    ctx.fillStyle = rimG;
    ctx.fill();

    // broth (inner ellipse)
    drawBroth(t);

    // warm rim light arc (top, shifted subtly by the mouse)
    var shift = (mouse.x - 0.5) * 0.7;
    ctx.save();
    ctx.globalCompositeOperation = 'lighter';
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.ellipse(cx, rimY, R * 0.985, RY * 0.985, 0, Math.PI * (1.18 + shift * 0.18), Math.PI * (1.85 - shift * 0.05));
    ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(255,199,122,0.55)';
    ctx.lineWidth = 2.6;
    ctx.stroke();
    ctx.restore();

    // faint cool rim on the lower edge
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.ellipse(cx, rimY, R * 0.985, RY * 0.985, 0, Math.PI * 0.12, Math.PI * 0.88);
    ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(130,150,185,0.10)';
    ctx.lineWidth = 1.6;
    ctx.stroke();
  }

  /* ---------------- steam ---------------- */
  function drawSteam(t, wind) {
    var cx = G.cx, rimY = G.rimY;
    ctx.save();
    ctx.globalCompositeOperation = 'lighter';
    for (var i = 0; i < wisps.length; i++) {
      var s = wisps[i];
      var baseX = cx + s.ox * G.innerR * 0.72;
      var baseY = rimY - 6;
      var len = G.R * s.h;
      var drift = wind * (0.35 + s.drift) * G.R * 0.55;
      var phase = s.phase + (motion ? t * s.speed : 0);
      var pts = [];
      var N = 26;
      for (var j = 0; j <= N; j++) {
        var p = j / N;
        var y = baseY - p * len;
        var x = baseX + Math.sin(phase + p * s.curl) * (5 + p * 34) + drift * p * p;
        pts.push([x, y, p]);
      }
      var passes = [
        { w: s.w * 2.3, a: 0.045 },
        { w: s.w * 1.35, a: 0.085 },
        { w: s.w * 0.66, a: 0.11 }
      ];
      for (var q = 0; q < passes.length; q++) {
        var ps = passes[q];
        var grad = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, baseY, 0, baseY - len);
        grad.addColorStop(0, 'rgba(255,241,222,' + (ps.a * s.alpha) + ')');
        grad.addColorStop(0.55, 'rgba(255,241,222,' + (ps.a * s.alpha * 0.6) + ')');
        grad.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(255,241,222,0)');
        ctx.strokeStyle = grad;
        ctx.lineWidth = ps.w;
        ctx.lineCap = 'round';
        ctx.lineJoin = 'round';
        ctx.beginPath();
        for (var j2 = 0; j2 < pts.length; j2++) {
          if (j2 === 0) ctx.moveTo(pts[j2][0], pts[j2][1]);
          else ctx.lineTo(pts[j2][0], pts[j2][1]);
        }
        ctx.stroke();
      }
    }
    ctx.restore();
  }

  /* ---------------- vignette & grain ---------------- */
  function drawVignette() {
    var vg = ctx.createRadialGradient(W / 2, H * 0.46, Math.min(W, H) * 0.30, W / 2, H * 0.50, Math.max(W, H) * 0.74);
    vg.addColorStop(0, 'rgba(0,0,0,0)');
    vg.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(3,2,2,0.60)');
    ctx.fillStyle = vg;
    ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);
  }

  function drawGrain() {
    if (!grainPattern) return;
    ctx.save();
    ctx.globalAlpha = 0.55;
    ctx.fillStyle = grainPattern;
    ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);
    ctx.restore();
  }

  /* ---------------- scene ---------------- */
  function render(t) {
    var flicker = motion
      ? (1 + Math.sin(t * 6.7) * 0.018 + Math.sin(t * 13.9 + 1.7) * 0.012)
      : 1;
    var wind = (mouse.x - 0.5);   // -0.5..0.5

    drawBackground(t, flicker, wind);
    drawTable(t);
    drawDust(t, wind);
    drawShadow();
    drawBowl(t);
    drawSteam(t, wind);
    drawVignette();
    drawGrain();
  }

  /* ---------------- data (stable across frames) ---------------- */
  var rnd = mulberry32(20240614);

  var dust = [];
  for (var i = 0; i < 26; i++) {
    dust.push({
      x: Math.random() * 1.0,   // normalized
      y: Math.random() * 1.0,
      r: 0.7 + Math.random() * 1.5,
      phase: Math.random() * Math.PI * 2,
      speed: 0.4 + Math.random() * 0.8,
      tw: 0.6 + Math.random() * 1.6
    });
  }

  var noodles = [
    { a: -0.72, b: 0.55, c: -0.28, d: 0.22, amp: 0.20, waves: 1.6, phase: 0.4, speed: 0.9 },
    { a: -0.35, b: 0.78, c: -0.05, d: -0.38, amp: 0.16, waves: 2.2, phase: 2.1, speed: 1.15 },
    { a: -0.15, b: 0.62, c: 0.46, d: 0.36, amp: 0.14, waves: 1.4, phase: 4.0, speed: 0.8 },
    { a: -0.78, b: 0.10, c: 0.10, d: 0.55, amp: 0.18, waves: 1.9, phase: 5.3, speed: 1.0 },
    { a: -0.45, b: 0.45, c: -0.55, d: 0.05, amp: 0.13, waves: 2.6, phase: 1.2, speed: 1.30 },
    { a: -0.05, b: 0.85, c: 0.05, d: -0.60, amp: 0.17, waves: 1.2, phase: 3.1, speed: 0.95 }
  ];

  var toppings = [
    { type: 'mushroom', x: -0.44, y: -0.32, s: 0.17, rot: -0.35 },
    { type: 'mushroom', x: 0.32, y: -0.44, s: 0.135, rot: 0.55 },
    { type: 'tofu', x: 0.55, y: 0.24, s: 0.155, rot: 0 },
    { type: 'bamboo', x: -0.68, y: 0.28, s: 0.135, rot: 0.5 },
    { type: 'bamboo', x: 0.72, y: -0.04, s: 0.115, rot: -0.7 },
    { type: 'leaf', x: -0.03, y: -0.44, s: 0.24, rot: 0.15 },
    { type: 'leaf', x: 0.66, y: 0.34, s: 0.165, rot: -0.95 }
  ];

  var scallions = [];
  for (var sc = 0; sc < 5; sc++) {
    scallions.push({
      x: (rnd() * 2 - 1) * 0.72,
      y: (rnd() * 2 - 1) * 0.58,
      r: 0.042 + rnd() * 0.018
    });
  }

  var sesame = [];
  for (var sm = 0; sm < 15; sm++) {
    sesame.push({
      x: (rnd() * 2 - 1) * 0.8,
      y: (rnd() * 2 - 1) * 0.62,
      rot: rnd() * Math.PI
    });
  }

  var oilDrops = [];
  for (var od = 0; od < 6; od++) {
    oilDrops.push({
      x: (rnd() * 2 - 1) * 0.70,
      y: (rnd() * 2 - 1) * 0.55,
      r: 0.028 + rnd() * 0.022
    });
  }

  var wisps = [];
  for (var wm = 0; wm < 6; wm++) {
    wisps.push({
      ox: (wm - 2.5) / 2.5,
      phase: rnd() * Math.PI * 2,
      speed: 0.55 + rnd() * 0.45,
      curl: 3.2 + rnd() * 2.2,
      w: 10 + rnd() * 12,
      h: 1.25 + rnd() * 0.85,
      drift: 0.5 + rnd() * 0.7,
      alpha: 0.75 + rnd() * 0.5
    });
  }

  /* ---------------- animation ---------------- */
  var STATIC_T = 2.35;
  var raf = null;
  var startT = 0;
  var lastFrame = 0;

  function spawnRipple(x, y) {
    // x,y in broth-local units (-1..1)
    ripples.push({ x: x, y: y, r: 0.02, a: 0.9, decay: 0.35 + Math.random() * 0.2 });
    if (ripples.length > 7) ripples.shift();
  }

  function spawnBubble() {
    bubbles.push({
      x: (Math.random() * 2 - 1) * 0.62,
      y: (Math.random() * 2 - 1) * 0.46,
      r: 0.012 + Math.random() * 0.02,
      life: 0,
      maxLife: 0.9 + Math.random() * 1.1
    });
    if (bubbles.length > 10) bubbles.shift();
  }

  function step(now) {
    raf = null;
    var dt = Math.min((now - lastFrame) / 1000, 0.05);
    lastFrame = now;
    var t = (now - startT) / 1000;

    // smoothing
    mouse.x += (target.x - mouse.x) * Math.min(1, dt * 5.5);
    mouse.y += (target.y - mouse.y) * Math.min(1, dt * 5.5);

    // ambient ripples & bubbles
    if (t - recentRippleAt > 3.4 + Math.random() * 2.2) {
      recentRippleAt = t;
      spawnRipple((Math.random() * 2 - 1) * 0.62, (Math.random() * 2 - 1) * 0.46);
    }
    if (t - recentBubbleAt > 0.55 + Math.random() * 0.9) {
      recentBubbleAt = t;
      spawnBubble();
    }

    // update
    for (var i = ripples.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
      var rp = ripples[i];
      rp.r += dt * 0.55;
      rp.a -= dt * rp.decay;
      if (rp.a <= 0 || rp.r > 0.85) ripples.splice(i, 1);
    }
    for (var j = bubbles.length - 1; j >= 0; j--) {
      var bu = bubbles[j];
      bu.life += dt;
      if (bu.life >= bu.maxLife) bubbles.splice(j, 1);
    }

    render(t);
    raf = requestAnimationFrame(step);
  }

  function startLoop() {
    if (raf) return;
    startT = performance.now();
    lastFrame = startT;
    raf = requestAnimationFrame(step);
  }

  function stopLoop() {
    if (raf) cancelAnimationFrame(raf);
    raf = null;
  }

  function applyMotion() {
    var reduce = mq.matches;
    motion = !reduce;
    if (motion) {
      startLoop();
    } else {
      stopLoop();
      ripples.length = 0; bubbles.length = 0;
      mouse.x = 0.5; mouse.y = 0.5; target.x = 0.5; target.y = 0.5;
      render(STATIC_T);
    }
  }
  mq.addEventListener('change', applyMotion);

  /* ---------------- events ---------------- */
  window.addEventListener('resize', resize);

  window.addEventListener('pointermove', function (e) {
    if (!motion) return;
    target.x = e.clientX / W;
    target.y = e.clientY / H;
  }, { passive: true });

  window.addEventListener('pointerleave', function () {
    target.x = 0.5; target.y = 0.5;
  });

  window.addEventListener('pointerdown', function (e) {
    if (!motion) return;
    // ripple at clicked point inside the broth
    var nx = (e.clientX - G.cx) / G.innerR;
    var ny = (e.clientY - G.rimY) / G.innerRY;
    if (nx * nx + ny * ny <= 1) {
      spawnRipple(nx, ny);
      spawnBubble();
    }
  }, { passive: true });

  /* ---------------- init ---------------- */
  makeGrain();
  resize();
  applyMotion();
})();
</script>
